description: Catch-all empty catalog_search for the search-records suite. The skill's 0-hit lever and exhaustive-exit checklist name catalog_search, and the unit harness registers only tools a test has fixtures for, so without this a catalog call is an unregistered-tool abort. It answers 0 hits so no test is graded on Catalog content. `~` with an empty needle matches any call that carries the key; this one covers calls with a place, its sibling catalog-search-empty-keywords covers calls with keywords.
